card.name: Word-start pieces like Prem and m
card.fires_on: Short word-start pieces that begin a longer word, mainly "prem" or "Prem" in premixed, premedicate and premature, and also "m" or "-m" starting mumps, micron or malaria. They often follow a sentence break or a number.

modes.label: Prem- words
modes.description: The start of premixed, Premedicate or Premature, often opening a sentence or following "physically".
modes.example: Amikacin should not be physically<< prem>>ixed with other drugs but should be administered

modes.label: M- word starts
modes.description: A bare m or -m that begins a word such as mumps, micron or malaria.
modes.example: Interfere with the response to live virus vaccines, such as measles, rubella,<< m>>umps and varicella.

card.writes: It promotes odd word-start pieces such as hy, ULA and Arr, which suggests it shapes how an unfinished word continues, but the effect is unclear.
card.plain: It fires on the first piece of a split word, especially the start of premixed, premedicate or premature.
